unmatched_reported.note: Under class-level @Transactional, the BadCredentialsException rolls back the LoginAttempt save, so the rate limit never counts failures; the trigger is concrete.
The oldest-ever attempt ignores windowStart, so Retry-After clamps to 1s while the lock is still active when stale rows exist.
Logout skips an already-used token, so a refresh that rotates the token concurrently leaves the successor unrevoked; the trigger is concrete.
The grace-window successor is chosen as the newest unused token across all sessions, so another device's token is consumed and reuse detection later fires.
A logout response arriving after the 3s race can clear a newly logged-in session's cookies, and a logout that never arrives leaves the refresh token unrevoked.
Hedged and speculative: it depends on an in-flight refresh happening to land after logout, and it asks the reader to confirm the hydration path.
handleLogout never resets MainLayout's persistent selfPlayerId ref, so the packs link keeps the previous player's id on a same-tab re-login.
